entries.msgid: A form is due

candidates.text: 表格到期

entries.msgid: A health worker completes one of the DAK's forms, a FHIR R4 Questionnaire conforming to Structured Data Capture, as their device renders it, and the point-of-care system turns the completed QuestionnaireResponse into the resources it stands for by the extraction the form declares (SDC $extract). Generic for any DAK: registering a client, recording a visit, a referral. A DAK's diagram calls it by call activity; the caller's lanes take on health-worker and point-of-care-system for the duration of the call. Skills: complete-sdc-questionnaire, extract-questionnaire-response (package authoring-who-smart-guidelines).

candidates.text: 一名卫生工作者填写了DAK表格中的一张,即FHIR R4问卷,该问卷与结构化数据采集相符,因为其设备可以提供,而护理点系统则将填写完毕的问卷回复转换成其提取表格(SDC $extrap)所代表资源。对于任何DAK来说,通用的表格是:注册客户、记录访问、查询。DAK的图表称它为呼叫活动;在通话期间,呼叫者使用卫生工作者和护理点系统。技能:完整问卷、抽取问卷回复(包装作者-谁-谁-聪明-指南)。

entries.msgid: A person in the health-worker role: completes the form with the client, confirming any pre-populated answer.

candidates.text: 从事保健工作者工作的人:与客户填写表格,确认任何预先获得的答案。

entries.msgid: Capture data with an SDC questionnaire

candidates.text: 带 SDC 问卷的捕获数据

entries.msgid: Complete the form

candidates.text: 填写表格

entries.msgid: Complete the SDC Questionnaire as the device renders it: confirm or correct each pre-populated answer, answer every enabled required item within its constraints, and submit. The result is a completed QuestionnaireResponse.

candidates.text: 按设备完成 SDC 问卷: 确认或纠正每个预选的答案, 在其限制范围内回答每个启用的必需项目并提交。 结果是完成的问卷回复 。

entries.msgid: Extract and save the resources

candidates.text: 提取并保存资源

entries.msgid: Form declares an extraction?

candidates.text: 表格显示抽取吗?

entries.msgid: Health worker

candidates.text: 卫生工作者

entries.msgid: no

candidates.text: 没有

entries.msgid: Point-of-care system

candidates.text: 护理点制度

entries.msgid: Read from the Questionnaire, not decided: an SDC extraction extension (targetStructureMap, itemExtractionContext or observationExtract) is present, or it is not.

candidates.text: 从调查表中读取,未决定:存在或没有SDC提取扩展(目标结构图、项目摘要或观测摘要)。

entries.msgid: Resources saved

candidates.text: 节省的资源

entries.msgid: Response stored

candidates.text: 反应已储存

entries.msgid: Run SDC $extract by the method the Questionnaire declares and save the resulting transaction Bundle whole, queued when offline.

candidates.text: 使用问卷声明的方法运行 SDC $extracte 并保存由此产生的交易包, 退出时排队 。

entries.msgid: The app or EHR the form is filled in: extracts and saves the resources, offline first.

candidates.text: 应用程序或 EHR 该表填入: 提取并保存资源, 首先脱机 。

entries.msgid: The client's resources, and the response they came from, are in the record.

candidates.text: 客户的资源 以及他们的反应 都记录在案

entries.msgid: The DAK's process reaches a step that records data on a form: registering a client, a visit, a referral.

candidates.text: DAK的程序达到了在表格上记录数据的一步:登记客户、访问、转介。

entries.msgid: The form declares no extraction: the QuestionnaireResponse itself is the record.

candidates.text: 表格未声明提取内容:调查表本身即为记录。

entries.msgid: yes

candidates.text: 对
